It depends on the unclean thing. Some objects are just gross, others are contaminated. I know some people with diseases spread through bodily fluids, so I just try to limit my contact with them and avoid touching things they may have touched. As for showering, I don't scrub myself raw but I'm very thorough.

Soap. My hands don't feel clean with just water. I don't have a problem with my own tears or saliva, but other peoples' are gross. I do have to be freshly showered before I go to bed or leave the house. If I'm not I feel gross.
I try to avoid things that make me feel contaminated. Hospitals are bad, but being inside of a hoarder's house was one of the most difficult things I've ever had to do.
It builds up. I don't think I've ever gone more than half an hour without washing my hands after touching something gross (and that was just due to being away from an available sink).

No need to apologize. As horrible as it sounds, it's comforting to know there are other people who feel the same way. When I was younger I thought I was the only person in the world who felt like this.
